children: William Blair expects COIN revenue to fall in 2026, earnings to trough late 2026, trading volume down ~44% in 2026 then up >32% in 2027; highlights retail derivatives revenue >$200M annualized.
COIN added transfers of existing stock portfolios and launched trading in major stocks, indexes and ETFs, expanding its platform beyond crypto to include stocks and options.
Coinbase (COIN) rolled out 1:1 tokenized stocks for non‑U.S. users last month; tokens carry dividends and voting rights and can serve as collateral for on‑chain loans on platforms like Aave.
Coinbase (COIN) will aggregate customer IPO orders via Apex Clearing, act as agent not underwriter, enforce a 30‑day selling hold on allocated IPO shares and reserve penalties for early resale
COIN offered pre-IPO derivatives, like June’s SpaceX perpetual futures, giving eligible non-U.S. users synthetic exposure to private companies before public listings.
COIN linked to new IPO allocation feature: allocations may be full, partial, or none based on supply and demand; includes short-term selling bans and reduced future allocations for repeat sellers
COIN fell about 5%–10% after the CLARITY Act vote and continued lower amid investor worry that proposed U.S. market-structure rules could hurt Coinbase’s trading business.
